name: 30303 · Atlanta, GA
findings: ZIP 30303 (Atlanta) has 365 nonprofit organizations. 188 of them (52%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 160 organizations.
Professional organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (19% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 30303 (Atlanta) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 30303 (Atlanta) list civic or political action in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 14.2 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 19 organizations here; 25% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to take civic or political action so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
